tasks.name: longest_rise_distinct

prompts.original: Write a Python function `longest_rise_distinct(numbers)` that returns the length of the longest stretch of strictly increasing neighbouring values in the different values of the list, each once, in order of first appearance (0 if there are none).

tasks.tests:
assert longest_rise_distinct([]) == 0
assert longest_rise_distinct([10]) == 1
assert longest_rise_distinct([19]) == 1
assert longest_rise_distinct([2, 4, -4, -8]) == 2
assert longest_rise_distinct([20, 8, 13, 16]) == 3
assert longest_rise_distinct([-8, 16, 20, 8]) == 3
tasks.reference:
def longest_rise_distinct(numbers):
    xs = numbers
    ys = list(dict.fromkeys(xs))
    best = run = 0
    for i, y in enumerate(ys):
        run = run + 1 if i > 0 and y > ys[i - 1] else 1
        best = max(best, run)
    return best
tasks.wrong:
def longest_rise_distinct(numbers):
    xs = numbers
    ys = [b - a for a, b in zip(xs, xs[1:])]
    best = run = 0
    for i, y in enumerate(ys):
        run = run + 1 if i > 0 and y > ys[i - 1] else 1
        best = max(best, run)
    return best
